usage.title: Usage
usage.sinceUnknown: Start of the window was not reported.
usage.noBuckets: The gateway reported no time buckets.

config.loadFailed: The configuration could not be checked: {message}
config.copy.failed: The path could not be copied: {message}
config.fontScale.note: OpenChamber does not pass its interface font size to extensions. Set fontScale in config.jsonc to the same percentage.
config.fontScale.invalid: fontScale in {path} must be an integer from 50 to 200; using 100%.
config.fatalNote: The file could not be used; the loopback default and the host language are in effect.

config.language.invalid: The language value in {path} is not a string; using the host language.

config.create.confirm: Create {path} with the six default settings?
config.create.exists: {path} already exists; it was left unchanged.
config.create.failed: The config file could not be created: {message}
config.init.markerFailed: The first-open marker could not be read or saved: {message}. Automatic creation is off; no config file was created or changed.
config.init.createFailed: The config file could not be created automatically: {message}. Use the button below to retry.
config.init.createdMarkerFailed: The config file was created, but the first-open marker could not be saved: {message}.
config.recovery: Rebuilt {path} at {at} after a syntax, duplicate-key, or root-shape error. The previous text is kept as comments at the end of the same file.
config.recovery.none: No field could be safely recovered; defaults are in effect.
footer.data: Data comes from the local service only. The panel keeps one first-open marker in host extension storage and never reads or shows a key.
error.host.noService: The local service is not approved. Open Settings → Extensions and allow it, then retry.
error.host.disabled: The extension is paused in Settings → Extensions.
error.host.serviceFailed: The local service stopped. It restarts on the next request.
error.host.requestFailed: The local service did not answer in time.
error.host.responseTooLarge: The local service answered with too much data.
error.http.notJson: The local service answered HTTP {status} with something that is not JSON.
error.shape.config: The local service answered /config with an unexpected shape.
error.shape.usage: The local service answered /v1/magpie/usage with an unexpected shape.
error.shape.quotas: The local service answered /v1/magpie/quotas with an unexpected shape.
error.service.badRequest: The panel asked for something the service does not serve.
error.service.configConflict: The config file changed on disk. Nothing was overwritten; retry.
error.service.internal: The local service failed to build an answer.
error.service.unauthorized: The gateway rejected the API key (HTTP 401). Check apiKey in the config file.
error.service.forbidden: The gateway refused this key (HTTP 403). It is limited to other models or accounts.
error.service.status: The gateway answered with an unexpected status.
error.service.timeout: The gateway did not answer in time.
error.service.network: The gateway could not be reached.
error.service.notJson: The gateway answered, but not with JSON.
error.service.schema: The gateway answered with JSON, but not with magpie usage data.
error.service.redirect: The gateway redirected to another origin. The redirect was not followed, so the key never leaves its origin.
error.service.unknown: The local service answered with an unknown error.
